findings.conditions: elph_prt with LSDA (nspin=2), several pools, the requested k point of spin 1 and of spin 2 held by two different pools, neither of them the ionode's pool
findings.reasoning: For each spin the root of the owning pool sends el_ph_mat to root_image with the same tag 4*nproc_image, and the ionode loops ispn=1,2 receiving with MPI_ANY_SOURCE. When the two spins come from two different senders, the receive meant for spin 1 can match the spin-2 sender's message (it may arrive first), so el_ph_mat2(:,:,1,:) and (:,:,2,:) are swapped depending on timing. The printed per-spin |g|, Re(g), Im(g) (labelled by ispn) then belong to the wrong spin channel, and the degeneracy averaging pairs them with the wrong spin's energies. The output changes from run to run with no error.

findings.conditions: same as above: LSDA, both spins' k point held by two different non-ionode pools
findings.reasoning: Both senders send et(:,ikk) and then et(:,ikq) with the same tag 6*nproc_image, and the ionode receives et2(:,1,ispn) and et2(:,2,ispn) (lines 1510 and 1512) with MPI_ANY_SOURCE. Non-overtaking holds only for each sender separately, so the four receives can interleave the two senders' messages in any order. et2(:,1,1) can be spin 2's e_k, or spin 1's e_k can land in the e_k+q slot of a different spin, and this happens independently of how the el_ph_mat receive matched. The degeneracy symmetrisation of epc over e_k and e_k+q, and the printed enk/enk+q columns, then use mismatched energies, giving run-dependent wrong |g_sym| values.

findings.conditions: band groups (nbgrp>1) inside the pool that owns the k point; or the ionode's own pool owns it and has more than one band group
findings.reasoning: The send condition is me_bgrp==root_bgrp, which is true for the root of every band group, so one pool sends nbgrp copies of each message while the ionode posts only one set of ANY_SOURCE receives per spin (none at all for a spin it found locally). The extra el_ph_mat MPI_SENDs, too large for eager delivery, never match and block forever, so the run hangs depending on MPI buffering. If they are buffered instead, the leftover messages stay queued, and the ANY_SOURCE receives of the next q point's elph_prt call match them, taking the previous q point's matrix and energies.
